signalsHint: Automatic signals, not findings: they become gaps only after analysis and human review.
signalsHidden: Signals are visible to facilitators and auditors only.
stopConfirm: Stop the exercise? It ends cleanly and the final gap detection runs.
surpriseHint: The surprise is inserted as an ad hoc event, marked as such in the ledger.
takeControlHint: Switching happens between two activations. History stays in the ledger:

trace.title: Decision trace — seat {{seat}}
trace.hint: Verifiable acts only: what the seat searched, what the model was called with, how each citation was checked, and what was recorded. No private reasoning is shown.
trace.noEventsHint: Your role does not see the seat's detailed events, or they are before the replay window.
trace.noLlm: No model call (scripted, replay or human).
trace.blobNote: Full prompts and raw outputs are stored by hash; the blob viewer is not exposed by the API yet.

invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask the facilitator for a new one.
nothingToDo: Nothing to do right now (exercise {{state}}). This page updates automatically.
researchHint: Search is limited to your knowledge bases. The adviser answers questions but never decides for you.
postHint: Messages are staged and sent when your turn closes.
decisionHint: Same rules as an AI agent: cite the text you rely on (exact quote) or declare that no legal basis was found.
legalBasisHint: Copy the chunk id and the exact quote from the search results above ({{kb}} base(s) available).

citationReasons.quote_not_in_chunk: the quote is not in the chunk text
citationReasons.not_retrieved: chunk not retrieved in this activation
citationReasons.article_mismatch: article does not match the chunk

flow.title: Exercise flow
flow.liveHint: Live: every action appears here as it happens.
flow.replayHint: Replay: walk through the exercise step by step.
flow.replay: Replay the exercise from the start
flow.replayLead: Relive the {{n}} steps: who received what, who searched for what, who decided what, and what the check verified.

say.search: {{seat}} searches its own documents: “{{query}}” ({{n}} excerpt(s) found).
say.citationOk: Automatic check: {{seat}}'s citations match the texts word for word ({{ok}}/{{n}}).
say.citationKo: Automatic check: {{seat}}'s citation is refused, it does not match the text ({{ok}}/{{n}} valid).
say.decisionOk: {{seat}} decides: “{{action}}”, relying on {{article}}. Legal basis verified.
say.decisionKo: {{seat}} decides “{{action}}”, but without a verifiable legal basis: the decision is flagged.
say.decisionNone: {{seat}} fails to produce a valid decision: nothing is recorded.
say.gap: The detector spots a gap signal: {{signal}}.
say.human: {{seat}} is waiting for a human decision.
say.state_completed: The exercise is over; final gap detection runs.
say.errorRetry: {{seat}} produced a malformed answer: the system rejects it and asks again.
say.errorFinal: {{seat}} again produced a malformed answer: it is discarded.

callout.citationKo: ✗ Citation refused: does not match the text

present.titleLead: Institutions in play: {{seats}}. Each one only knows its own mandates and documents.
present.subtitleStart: Ready. Space or click to release the first event.
present.endLeadGaps: {{n}} gap signal(s) for humans to review, each with its evidence chain.
present.endLeadClean: No gap signal: every decision rests on a verified text.
present.keys: Space / → : next · ← : previous · P : autoplay · Q : audience QR · F : full screen · Esc : leave

audience.title: Let the audience play
audience.lead: Hand an institution to someone in the room: they play it from their phone, against the AI agents, under the same rules (cite a verified text).
audience.name: Display name
audience.liveHint: Exercise running: the switch applies between two activations (a few seconds).
audience.setupHint: Exercise not started: the seat will be held by a human from launch.
audience.heldBy: Seat held by “{{name}}”; personal link valid for 12 hours.
audience.localhost: This page is open on “localhost”: a phone will not be able to open the link. Start the frontend with “npm run dev -- --host” and open the interface via this machine's IP address.
audience.terminal: This exercise is over: no player can join it any more. Start a new exercise to let the audience play.

alerts.interruptedText: The server stopped during the exercise (restart). Nothing is lost: everything is in the ledger. Click “Resume” to continue where it stopped.
alerts.waitingTitle: {{seat}} is waiting for a human decision ({{name}})
alerts.waitingText: The player must open their personal link (QR code) to decide. Otherwise, give the seat back to the AI agent.
alerts.deadlineAgent: The AI agent takes over automatically in {{time}}.
alerts.deadlineSkip: The turn will be skipped in {{time}}.

citeHint: Tip: search a text, then “Cite this excerpt” fills in the citation for you.
needBasis: At least one citation is required (search a text, then “Cite this excerpt”), or choose the outcome “No legal basis found”.
